newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Chinese president to visit Pakistan in December.
newsitem.headline: Chinese president to visit Pakistan in December.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin will pay a four-day visit to Pakistan from December 1, the Pakistan foreign ministry said on Thursday.

The President, whose visit was planned about two months ago at the invitation of President Farooq Leghari, would be accompanied by Vice Premier Qian Qichen, who is also foreign minister, and other officials, a ministry spokesman said.

Pakistan and China were likely to sign agreements for cooperation in environmental protection and for the continuation of Pakistan's consulate-general in Hong Kong when the territory reverts to Chinese rule in July 1997, the spokesman said.
The Chinese team was likely to announce development aid worth 50 million yuan ($6.2 million).

Pakistan has enjoyed close relations with China, including defence cooperation, from the 1960s. In recent years, the two countries have been accused of secret nuclear and missile deals, which both have denied.
